tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Flag red — the primary brand colour: primary buttons, active nav, links, heroes, the logo pin. White (on-red) text on it (5.9:1).

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of red; text on red-soft (7.8:1).

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, icon wells on service tiles, the AI-suggestion card.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Eagle gold — the action accent: the floating Report button, the logo's dot, budget 'in plan' highlights, badges. Always black ink on it (7.7:1), never white.

tokens.name: gold-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of gold buttons and the FAB; ink text on it (6.1:1).

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Background of In-progress chips, budget 'selected' rows and community badges.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Text on gold-soft and gold text on white (6.4:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Flag black — body text and headings (16.8:1 on paper); the admin sidebar and the Nile in the skyline.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, helper text, captions (6.4:1 on paper).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on red.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Flag white — the page background, a slightly warm white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, tables, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers; never text.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink surfaces: the admin sidebar, the docbar, code blocks (15.8:1).

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink (sidebar captions and counts, 8.6:1).

tokens.name: icon-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholder icon on a photo-less thumbnail (on status-received, 5.9:1).

tokens.name: map-ground
tokens.usage: Ground colour of the static map illustration. Never text.

tokens.name: status-received
tokens.usage: Text of the Received chip (on status-received-bg).

tokens.name: status-received-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Received chip.

tokens.name: status-assigned
tokens.usage: Text of the Assigned chip; assigned map pins.

tokens.name: status-assigned-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Assigned chip.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: Text of the In-progress chip (on gold-soft).

tokens.name: status-progress-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the In-progress chip (same value as gold-soft).

tokens.name: status-resolved
tokens.usage: Text of the Resolved chip; resolved map pins.

tokens.name: status-resolved-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Resolved chip.

tokens.name: urgent
tokens.usage: Critical priority and errors. A darker red than the brand red; always paired with a word (خطر، عاجل) or a warning icon so it never reads as decoration. White text on it (7.8:1).

tokens.name: urgent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the soft خطر tag (.ftc-tag-danger), the emergency hotline box and error banners. The filled Critical chip uses urgent.

tokens.name: urgent-deep
tokens.usage: Text on urgent-soft.

families.display: "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips' inner elements, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Service tiles, bottom sheets, the map frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, filter chips, the floating Report button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles resting on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating Report button, map popups, bottom sheets.
